name: shelf-platform
description: Shelf — shopping intelligence platform. Unified search, product identity matching and price comparison across authorized marketplace affiliate sources.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shelf/shared && npm run build --workspace @shelf/integrations && npm run build --workspace @shelf/backend
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b shared integrations backend workers database && npm run typecheck --workspace @shelf/frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run lint
